responsibility: Implements MIR type checking for borrow checking, collecting liveness, outlives, placeholder, member, closure-bound, and type-test constraints while validating statements, terminators, local declarations, and trait obligations against the MIR’s types.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the borrow-check MIR type-checking entry point that validates MIR typing and emits region/member/type-test constraints. Unlike the sibling `mod.rs` files for region inference, diagnostics, or constraints, it is the stage that produces many of the facts those later stages consume.
